g.text: Why this is a useful evaluation contribution
An initially correct answer can still fail during the next exchange.
A reusable protocol with multiple controls
Length, attribution and source appear in one framework.
The protocol, records and MaxFlip support follow-up evaluation.
The contribution is measurement and characterization; the paper does not test a fix.
